newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end near highs in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end near highs in thin trade.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended within a whisper of their day's highs on Monday as a bout of late short-covering lifted the market, but turnover remained thin, dealers said.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 June contract added 215 points to close at 18,055, just five points below its intra-day high, on volume of 12,500 lots.
"The market was pretty thin so it's not surprising it went up so quickly. There was heavy short-covering by locals," said a trader with a Japanese futures house.
Dealers said the Dow's firm close last week and the dollar's continued strength against the yen underpinned the market in the absence of fresh leads.
The trader said the June Nikkei showed potential to reach 18,250 on Tuesday if the Dow extended its gains, but he added that the contract would face a strong barrier around 18,330.
The March MSCI Taiwan index contract ended at 361.7 against its opening 352.0 on volume of 485 lots.
